en-AU.title: AMARI
en-AU.subtitle: Private diaspora network
en-AU.description:
AMARI is an invite-only membership network for Australia's Black diaspora - professionals, entrepreneurs, creatives, investors, operators, founders, and community builders shaping culture and commerce across the continent.

AMARI gives members a private, curated space to connect with intention, access community intelligence, discover opportunities, and build relationships that compound over time.

The Pulse provides concise intelligence for members who want signal without noise.

Aligned supports curated introductions across the community.

The Corridor helps members discover private business, talent, partnership, investment, and collaboration opportunities.

Events bring members together through curated gatherings built for genuine connection.

AMARI is invite-only. Members enter through verified invitations and approved account access so the community can grow with trust, quality, and shared intent.

By invitation only.
en-AU.releaseNotes: Adds secure onboarding, improved sign-in reliability, visible map borders, and production release hardening.
en-AU.promoText: A private, invite-only network for Australia's Black diaspora.
